lines.sentence: Once upon a time, as many of our stories start, the universe was composed of parts and pieces scattered in random and wild directions separated by vast expanses of nothing. Pieces of three beings who had the power to control reality.
One of these beings, loud and passionate, is the queen of everything that exists. Everything that you can see, feel, hear, is all a part of her. She is the Light that fills our lives.

The second of these beings is wild and unpredictable, she slips in and around people as motion, emotion, and energy. Even compared to the bright voice of Light, this second being was nothing but pure Chaos.

The third and final being, is entropy and emptiness. Everything that never existed, or doesn’t exist any longer. Unspoken words and histories past. The absence of existence, where there’s nothing but Silence.

One day, Light and Chaos held each other so close, that once they parted, pieces of them had stuck together. A universe, A world. Plants, animals, and from the animals, people. Everything that exists was so big and so full of the love of these beings that Silence was receded in order to make room for it.

Another that came into existence along the world, were spirits with the power to govern and care for the newly created world. Essences that were able to gain power from the world itself as well as the people who chose to worship them.
